parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD.
> Only a single domain name is supported.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed one year. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.
- Default value: **300**
- Maximum value: **1000**

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).
